pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Goodbye, Sir.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Njeri.
   B. Ça va bien, merci.
   C. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   D. Ça s'écrit comment ?

2. What does 'la douche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the TV
   B. the shower
   C. the table
   D. the chair

3. What does 'Il y a du soleil.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is raining.
   B. What is the weather like?
   C. It is sunny.
   D. It is cold.

4. Fill in: La porte est ______ la fenêtre. (next to) (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. sous
   C. à côté de
   D. dans

5. What does 'Où est le chat ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the cat?
   B. The ball is behind the door.
   C. Put the book on the table.
   D. The TV is in the living room.

6. How do you say the month 'February' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mars
   B. septembre
   C. novembre
   D. février

7. What number is 'trois' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 3

8. What does 'le temps' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the storm
   B. the snow
   C. the weather
   D. the wind

9. How do you say 'a birthday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un mois
   B. un cadeau
   C. un anniversaire
   D. une bougie

10. What number is 'dix-sept' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 25

11. What does 'Il fait beau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot.
   B. I stay in the house.
   C. The weather is nice.
   D. Tomorrow the weather is nice.

12. What does 'les légumes' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the banana
   B. cheese
   C. chicken
   D. vegetables

13. What does 'Elle est petite.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. He is tall.
   B. She is short.
   C. He has short hair.
   D. I have a mouth.

14. How do you say 'I eat a mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je mange une mangue.
   B. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   C. C'est bon pour la santé.
   D. Ce sont des mangues.

15. Fill in: Le ballon est ______ la porte. (behind) (1 mark)
   A. devant
   B. sur
   C. entre
   D. derrière

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'In the kitchen, there is a fridge.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

17. Give three French greetings and say when you would use each one. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'It is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Write the numbers from 11 to 15 in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Je bois un jus.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Au revoir, Monsieur.
   Goodbye, Sir. in French is Au revoir, Monsieur.

2. B — the shower
   la douche means the shower.

3. C — It is sunny.
   Il y a du soleil. means It is sunny.

4. C — à côté de
   À côté de means next to.

5. A — Where is the cat?
   Où est le chat ? means Where is the cat?

6. D — février
   February in French is février.

7. D — 3
   trois means 3.

8. C — the weather
   le temps means the weather.

9. C — un anniversaire
   a birthday in French is un anniversaire.

10. B — 17
   dix-sept means 17.

11. C — The weather is nice.
   Il fait beau. means The weather is nice.

12. D — vegetables
   les légumes means vegetables.

13. B — She is short.
   Elle est petite. means She is short.

14. A — Je mange une mangue.
   I eat a mango. in French is Je mange une mangue.

15. D — derrière
   Derrière means behind.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour in the day, bonsoir in the evening, au revoir when leaving; salut for friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting with a correct use.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il pleut.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: onze, douze, treize, quatorze, quinze
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: I drink a juice.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
